prompt: Create an original 120 second chamber classical instrumental composition for travel montage, walking and urban exploration. Mood: moving, bright, relaxed. Instruments: string quartet, clarinet. Style: interlocking counterpoint and expressive legato. Tempo approximately 94 BPM; E minor. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Use a forward-moving motif and recurring short instrumental answers. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:40] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:40-01:20] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:20-02:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:00.

description.en: An elegant and melancholic classical piece performed by a string ensemble. It features a rich, expressive melody with dynamic shifts, showcasing both pizzicato and arco techniques. The arrangement is sophisticated, evoking a sense of drama and introspection.
description.zh: 一首由弦乐合奏团演奏的优雅而忧郁的古典乐曲。它以丰富、富有表现力的旋律和动态变化为特色，展示了拨弦和弓弦两种演奏技巧。编曲精致，营造出一种戏剧性和内省感。
